purpose: Align the drawer Creation Packet Contract V2 with the NetSuite-side SuiteScript direct-write scaffold before live writes are enabled.
serverValidationOrder: idbReviewedPacket present or body is packet
Creation Packet Contract V2 is present
contract record count matches reviewed records
idempotency keys are present and unique
rollback labels and trace-result requirements are present
createUpdateRules: Customer uses create_or_update_customer with company name and website lookup.
Transaction uses create_sales_order_context and depends on the customer.
Proof anchor uses create_or_update_proof_item only when the reviewed DCC new-item toggle supports it.
Supporting proof records depend on customer and proof anchor and must respect manufacturing and WIP toggles.
Every future write must return trace result fields before the next dependent write proceeds.
partialFailureHandling: Return blocked while CREATE_ENABLED is false.
Return failed for invalid packet shape before any future write attempt.
In a future enabled branch, return partial_failed after any successful parent write followed by a dependent write failure.
Never silently continue dependent records after a required parent fails.
Never silently remove records as a rollback substitute; surface rollback labels and record IDs in trace.
